notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/35094948/7bf0f72feda243af1df42f81d5973459d413e37b.jpg[/img]
[b][h1]The fourth major expansion for Heads Will Roll: Reforged has been released![/h1][/b]
[previewyoutube=I0jVrLytCLA;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3857000/Heads_Will_Roll_Reforged__Sins_of_the_Floating_City/

[h2]What awaits you in the DLC:[/h2]
- No step too far, no measure too desperate:
Become the right hand man of the Venetian Doge and plunge headlong into the maelstrom of European politics to help Venice survive the onslaught of an alliance of its many rivals. Enlist the help of allies and defeat your enemies on the battlefield or, through cunning intrigues and sophisticated machinations, set them against each other in order to reap the fruits of their discord. Deception, betrayal, bribery and political assassinations - achieve your goal by any means available and dare to take the most desperate steps for the sake of the greatness of Venice.

- A descent into darkness:
Enter the service of an influential Italian noble house, surrounded by enviers and grudge-bearers, and take on the role of a bodyguard who will protect its members from the dangers that lurk everywhere and the traps set by their enemies. Descend into darkness as you make your way through the Venice's underworld that will confront you with powerful secret societies, mysticism, blood feuds and the many vices and sins of human nature.

- More than a dozen new characters:
From members of various Italian noble houses and famous condottierros to the emperor of the Holy Roman Empire himself.

- Europe-spanning adventure:
Visit Italy, France, Holy Roman Empire and the Outremer all within one continuous campaign.

- 2 new romantic interests:
Each with their own unique story and character.

[h1]Special Offer.[/h1]
To celebrate the release of the new expansion, all previous DLCs are now 50% off
If you’ve been waiting for the best opportunity to grab the game, now is the time: the base game is 75% off.

notes.title: NO MERCY RETRO FPS — Meet HMUR!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/35094948/db35c03d0fda7640f3f2aeb39b155175281e3729.jpg[/img]
Greetings to all old-school shooter fans!

Let us introduce HMUR — a fast-paced retro FPS that throws you into a twisted, alternative version of the Soviet Union in the 1990s. Combining the insane mechanics of 90s shooters, Soviet sci-fi aesthetics, and a pounding hardbass soundtrack, the game becomes a relentless dance of speed, precision, and madness.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3499560/HMUR/"][/dynamiclink]
You are Sergey, an ordinary worker. Something went terribly wrong, and now your only chance to survive is to be faster than death. [p][/p][p]Be sure to watch the trailer: 
[previewyoutube=zVDyBBJkbxk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]PLAYTEST SIGN-UPS ARE NOW OPEN![/h2]
Want to be among the first to push HMUR to its limits? Sign up for the playtests right now on the game’s Steam page.  
When the playtests begin, you’ll receive a notification.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45728763/c230685cb4e8eca1cb8c821061c7c2fb03d15bc4.jpg[/img]

WHAT AWAITS PLAYTEST PARTICIPANTS:
[list]
[*] One life and endless restarts — in the spirit of Hotline Miami.
[*] Maximum mobility: dodge, jump, flank your enemies.
[*] Non-linear levels — choose your path and adapt your strategy on the fly.
[*] Huge arsenal — shotguns, assault rifles, heavy weapons. But ammo is worth its weight in gold.
[*] Original soundtrack — techno, hardbass, and breakcore merging with the firefight into a single rhythm.
[*] The atmosphere of a secret Soviet facility in the grip of disaster.
[/list]

[h2]🏆 EXCLUSIVE REWARD:[/h2]
Complete the playtest build — and earn an achievement. Upon release, it will turn into a golden pistol skin. This is not just a weapon, but a symbol that you survived where others gave up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45728763/d722637b181d78f5ca45fba4570339a82a764422.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45728763/76bdbfb56a930ee05fad6db4fb7d286628267475.jpg[/img]

[h3]HMUR is created by a solo developer.[/h3]
By participating in the playtests, each of you becomes part of the game’s development story. Join the [url=https://discord.gg/TbvXbvzZTZ]Discord[/url] and become part of the community.

notes.title: Content update DOOMER №1 is available! Changelog post.
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44355443/2152978a1c153df1a05982cbf23fa164c59ddb1d.jpg[/img]

[previewyoutube=n5YBh0wvxQc;full][/previewyoutube]

Greetings from the Doomer development team! 

We apologize for the long absence of any news and game updates since the announcement of our roadmap. As is often the case, everything that could go wrong went wrong. As we built all the processes and implemented what we promised, it took more time than expected.

Now that the time has come, we are pleased to present you with the first content update, which is quite significant in scope, but represents only a small part of what's planned.

Let's talk about future plans before we get into the details of the update. From now on, we'll release updates more frequently. We can't reveal the content or dates yet, but there won't be such long breaks between updates anymore. In the next step, we'll rework the technical foundation of the game, optimize everything that's "under the hood", and then start developing game mechanics.  

And yes, you read that right, Doomer will feature game mechanics and a clearly defined gameplay cycle. And naturally, we will add more nostalgic items, references, and elements that are signature to the time. 

Sincerely yours, the Doomer team.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1793150/Doomer/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1793150/Doomer/[/url]

Now for the content update:

[h3]1) Character:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Doomer can now run, jump, and crouch; 
[*] When running, the camera wobbles more intensely than when walking; 
[*] Removed camera shake with the option to turn it on if you want to; 
[*] The phone model has been updated to Pokia :), which is more relevant to the time when the game takes place. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/a188f61e42894362f6dbb6bd19c2a4fc4ea0527a.png[/img]

[*] The phone interface has been updated with the ability to call, but no one will answer...yet.
[*] The ability to take photos through the phone has been removed, since it does not correspond to the time of the game. We will get back to this and explore ideas of how to do photos and screenshots later. However, it won't be done with the phone camera, that is for sure.
[*] A redesigned item interaction system has been added. For example, the rat isn't a part of your pocket anymore. It lives in the cage. You can get it out and put it back in.
[*] Like any doomer character can now die, there are several ways to do that. Feel free to experiment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/3e68d2ac9c7474b79bd45d5cb99dbf2d07a1ff5e.png[/img]

[h3]2) Doomers apartment: [/h3]
[list]
[*] You are able to open and close almost all of the doors and windows in the apartment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/5cff5bcf28629d3bccc022a901099b6a09f0aeee.png[/img]

[*] Now, there are switches in all rooms, so lights can be turned on and off.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/b3d54fe0f6aa26a5e0e0a21749cc4e7d1b02a681.png[/img]

[*] A gas stove can be lit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/98dfcd234bd4ae7c34de82ee0425524b897f0adf.png[/img]

[*] Lots and lots of authentic items that are appropriate for the time the events of the game take place. Brand new models of items made from scratch, including Dendy consoles, cartridges, videotapes, books, Great Dragon and Technics of Youth magazines, as well as video and audio tape recorders. There is no sense to list it all, just explore and enjoy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/da0d2dc40de74973c52b9f4b9aafbb0ba00a3db3.png[/img]

[*] It is now possible to pick up and inspect items. At the moment, not all of the items are eligible for that, but we will be gradually adding the ability to inspect them all.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/d0462bd2891aadd4e39545f58ff27014393bbe9f.png[/img]

[*] You can now watch TV

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/4733d70221e4a1471087a9f3680376decc5c4f2c.png[/img]

[*] The apartment has a telephone now, you should expect a call.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/0d68cd37f25ba3bc4c6c04775a1246941081907a.png[/img]

[*] There has been a change in the apartment's furnishings. Now that Doomer has a new table, he has rearranged some stuff around the apartment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/a0829a33c001b6476d352c65d53fc1b5737e4da3.png[/img]
[/list]

[h3]3) Other: [/h3]
[list]
[*] The apartment building has the entrance now, you can access it from the doomers apartment. It allows you to go out onto the street, or access the roof. We attempted to make the entrance as authentic as possible using relevant objects and attributes of the time, writings on the walls, ashtrays, bottles, etc. You can explore, ring your neighbors doorbells and find ways to entertain yourself, maybe getting an achievement or two while you are at it. We'll add more activities over time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/21af654deca04ab7b71da3c2f58b8e0c5866fc48.png[/img]

[*] You can access the roof now. There you can walk around, smoke a cigarette and contemplate about your life while looking at the surrounding landscape from above. That, and all other sorts of activities you can think of.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/ed588cf12a3e2d49c65d176816eb067478b96803.png[/img]

[*] The lighting has been updated, smoothly transitioning to dynamic lighting;
[*] A variety of ambient sounds, clocks, birds outside the window, street noise, computer startup, and others have been added;
[*] Picked bottles can be thrown anywhere if you click the left mouse button after picking them up. Give it a try, experiment with it...
[*] The railroad in the area is now fully operational. Watch the departing train doomer and think about life...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/22e9c53431eab3db83538a30e8ebaa4288659f6a.png[/img]

[*] There are many hidden activities now. We won't reveal them, but we are sure you'll enjoy finding them. Don't be afraid to explore the neighborhood and the apartment, something interesting is surely waiting for you there.
[*] Lines 97 is now installed on the computer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/148831f1c301faefebc99afe8b59060462602009.png[/img]

[*] Several parked cars appeared on the streets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/f6c1c58ff973e05e6ba858dcb99dbe29dbb768d2.png[/img]

[*] The apartment buildings themselves were embellished with authentic external elements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/39c98f3492ff6d169f16dc25766b04390af4f81d.png[/img]

[*] Old achievements have been remade to match the spirit of the game and the changes we've made. You'll find new secret achievements as well, look for ways to unlock them and just have fun.  
[/list]

[h3]Enjoy the game!!![/h3]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1793150/Doomer/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1793150/Doomer/[/url]

notes.title: Huge update for Zombie Road Rider! New maps and new zombies!
notes.content:
Hi people!

[b]Zombie Road Rider[/b] has received a [b]huge update[/b] that was on the work for some times now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1175640/Zombie_Road_Rider/

Actually, the game has received a series of updates since the last news that was posted last year ago! So what is new?

A full new environment to play! The [b]City Downtown[/b] ! Set in an environment made of skyscrapers and large roads, save the survivors who are running around and bring them to the safe house!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/95a0d1b7264481b6ac5e137bf3a7d2fe666b76aa.jpg[/img]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/8f4e97a8c6bfae9a50ea725db8a7de4d3c9d0064.jpg[/img]

Another new environment, the [b]Industrial Town[/b]! Set in narrow streets with old industrial style buildings, largely populated with fully physics-based props, obstacles and zombies to road ride!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/98f1e6fe837711a742a3775547dfccf23bc79310.jpg[/img]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/fee8a8ddef73791dcacdc55f7d52fc7fca266e03.jpg[/img]

[b]The Factory[/b], a modern industrial type place with barricades and zombies to destroy!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/ade6a5df7052809be50173755ebab3f195d6ac41.jpg[/img]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/a7e51c4dc1321136d3d203c7e5a49f4ee1aa8802.jpg[/img]

Another one main new aspect of the game is that [b]+30 zombies were added [/b]to replace the old classic one, so that the game has more variety of characters!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/d026c4dfa1436d565e546f9a344a423bbf313c46.jpg[/img]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/79c36fe1d10ef8ab1a5221af2a1626267cdd9578.jpg[/img]

[b]Physics of the cars and vehicles were reworked[/b] to feel more enjoyable and powerful against the obstacles and zombies on the road. Improvements were made on the graphics and the optimisation of the game to have it run more smoothly. The menu and user interface was also reworked to be more intuitive and easier to use.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0qe6t-gvPVg

The environments that were added have support for both rescue and freeride game mode!

So this pretty sum up all what you will find in this large update! I hope you will enjoy!

Best,
Devdan

notes.title: Gameplay and content update for Action Alien
notes.content:
An update has been released for Action Alien almost 3 years after its release. This update consists in improvements, tweaks for the gameplay and new features being added to the game.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9197771/f366491304ad40f2d6365f0c7cb4614649672444.jpg[/img]

The main feature added is the [b]cinematic[/b] made for each map which improves the immersion and narrative dimension of the game by giving overviews of the incoming action with short introduction sequences.

A lot of [b]optimisation[/b] was  also done for the aliens and other 3D models to improve the in-game frame-rate, especially for the tropical map where the tropical foliage and the bungalows had their geometry optimized with more level of details.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9197771/b0136c6f7fae9231f6d18f310e43ac1d5af3f1bc.jpg[/img]

About the changes made for the gameplay, these have in mind to make the game easier and more intuitive to play. Things such as cross-hair being added to the pistol and the sten to give a better aiming, grenades faster to throw, there is now also unlimited sprint to make it possible to flee the aliens or to collect items faster.

The hunting rifle is still firing at the same rate but is now inflicting much more damages to the aliens. Grabbing heavy items won't slow you down as much as before to remove the annoying feeling of being very slow when collecting them.

A fix has also been done for the [b]arena maps for an issue where too many aliens would spawn at the end[/b], as this was often creating lags spikes and make impossible to play for longer.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9197771/02de7408cdd30efea13d870ebb9a6f1362758e1a.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9197771/df2cc29b7ee8ef8662855bfbeba4b14d4f3da884.jpg[/img]

To sum it, here is the change list :
[list]
[*]Cinematic added to the wasteland map
[*]Cinematic added to the tropical hotel map
[*]Cinematic added to the petrol station map
[*]Grenades faster to throw
[*]Less slowing down when carrying items
[*]No more sprint limit
[*]Optimisations for the tropical foliage
[*]Optimisations for the destructible bungalows
[*]Hunting rifle is now inflicting more damages
[*]Less colored aliens
[*]Changed metal impact sound to a less harsh one
[*]Fixed over spawning of aliens in arena maps
[*]Some minor fixes...
[/list]

Additionally, support for Mac OS X may be available soon !

Cheers,
[i]Devdan[/i]
[url]http://devdangames.com[/url]

notes.title: Change of the title and adding of the survival mode !
notes.content:
[h1]Adding of the survival game mode ![/h1]
In the last update, one of the main feature which has been added was [b]the perk system and the upgraded weapons[/b] unlockable with points earned when defeating aliens. To make this feature even more enjoyable, [b]2 maps with a survival game mode have now been added to the game ![/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9197771/600f52e3c9c9d7c10586eef3966cd10c4f6a2170.jpg[/img]

These 2 maps are different from the previous ones in the way that the goal is no more to find and collect some items or complete some objectives, but instead it is [b]to hold on against an endless stream of aliens for as long as possible to achieve the maximum score ![/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9197771/2cb5a4b288e14ac73be2f8146f35796dd0cd09af.jpg[/img]

Unlocking perks and upgraded weapons will have all it's sense here since firing explosive ammo with the ability of making high jumps will obviously help you to survive longer !

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9197771/441639b500898ce58e9e990767febfab3f5ee177.jpg[/img]

These new maps are set in a similar environment as the previous one, and are of course fully destructible ! They are however smaller in order to concentrate the action in few hotspots.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9197771/6be714e92db0cd16402d23a74421445e838fa8ca.jpg[/img]

Thanks to the help of a Steam user, with this update [b]the game can now also be played with a xbox-like controller ![/b] This will give a different gameplay experience compared to the classic mouse/keyboard combo. Also, a bunch of bug fixes and overall optimisations were made.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9197771/8be3c0d427b8ca48e98b54605748feac537fb23e.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9197771/800ddc3e173abaafe6e9d6feb52bb3114c913928.jpg[/img]
http://store.steampowered.com/app/382080

[h1]Changing the title of the game from [b]The Alien Wasteland[/b] to [b]Action Alien[/b][/h1]
Otherwise, an important thing you may have noticed is that the title of the game has changed from [b]The Alien Wasteland[/b] to [b]Action Alien[/b]. The reason behind this is simple ; a developer from [b]inXile Entertainment[/b], the company which released the RPG [b]Wasteland 2[/b] has contacted me claiming that titling my game "The Alien Wasteland" was an infringement to their trademark "Wasteland".

Because both games have almost nothing in common and no case of confusion was ever reported for almost two years since my game was first announced, I have been calmly explaining through long emails why we should have no worries about this. But I finally ended up receiving a cease and desist letter from their lawyer asking to either stop using "wasteland" or to prepare facing legal actions against me.

Since I don't have the time nor the strength to deal with legal actions from this developer and its lawyers, or even taking the risk of having my game to be taken down from Steam, I decided to change the title to solve this issue, even though this has been a great loss in time and efforts for a very questionable complaint.

So I decided to choose for the new title [b]Action Alien[/b], which gives a good idea of what the game is about ! This is just one of the many headaches in game development, but at least the game is now much more complete with this update !

Thanks for reading.

[b][i]UPDATE - 05 MAY 2016[/i][/b] Since my trademark issue with inXile Entertainment has been taking much more attention than I thought, I have written a more detailed post about my exchange with them to clarify the situation : http://steamcommunity.com/games/382080/announcements/detail/840296458592791633
Devdan
http://actionalien.com

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9197771/6be714e92db0cd16402d23a74421445e838fa8ca.jpg[/img]

Thanks to the help of a Steam user, with this update [b]the game can now also be played with a xbox-like controller ![/b] This will give a different gameplay experience compared to the classic mouse/keyboard combo. Also, a bunch of bug fixes and overall optimisations were made.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9197771/8be3c0d427b8ca48e98b54605748feac537fb23e.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9197771/800ddc3e173abaafe6e9d6feb52bb3114c913928.jpg[/img]
http://store.steampowered.com/app/382080

[h1]Changing the title of the game from [b]The Alien Wasteland[/b] to [b]Action Alien[/b][/h1]
Otherwise, an important thing you may have noticed is that the title of the game has changed from [b]The Alien Wasteland[/b] to [b]Action Alien[/b]. The reason behind this is simple ; a developer from [b]inXile Entertainment[/b], the company which released the RPG [b]Wasteland 2[/b] has contacted me claiming that titling my game "The Alien Wasteland" was an infringement to their trademark "Wasteland".

Because both games have almost nothing in common and no case of confusion was ever reported for almost two years since my game was first announced, I have been calmly explaining through long emails why we should have no worries about this. But I finally ended up receiving a cease and desist letter from their lawyer asking to either stop using "wasteland" or to prepare facing legal actions against me.

Since I don't have the time nor the strength to deal with legal actions from this developer and its lawyers, or even taking the risk of having my game to be taken down from Steam, I decided to change the title to solve this issue, even though this has been a great loss in time and efforts for a very questionable complaint.

So I decided to choose for the new title [b]Action Alien[/b], which gives a good idea of what the game is about ! This is just one of the many headaches in game development, but at least the game is now much more complete with this update !

Thanks for reading.

[b][i]UPDATE - 05 MAY 2016[/i][/b] Since my trademark issue with inXile Entertainment has been taking much more attention than I thought, I have written a more detailed post about my exchange with them to clarify the situation : http://steamcommunity.com/games/382080/announcements/detail/840296458592791633
Devdan
http://actionalien.com

notes.title: Achievements, trading cards, perks system and unlockable weapons !
notes.content:
With the idea of extending the playability of the game, I have added many features that will enhance the overall gameplay and make the game more integrated into Steam !

Here are the main features coming with this update :

[h1]Achievements[/h1]
About [b]19 Steam achievements[/b] were added and are now unlockable ! These achievements vary from making distinguished actions during combats to completing levels and killing a number of aliens in a specific manner like with grenades or leg kicks, etc...

[img]http://actionalien.com/steam/2016_04_11/achievements.jpg[/img]

[h1]Trading Cards[/h1]
The game has now [b]6 trading cards on Steam[/b] which will unlock many backgrounds related to the game to customize an user profile on Steam, as well as many emoticons usable on the forums. There are also 6 different badges starting from "Armed Hitchhiker" to "Legend of the Wasteland" !

[img]http://actionalien.com/steam/2016_04_11/trading_cards.jpg[/img]

[h1]Perk System[/h1]
Now each time you play and manage to defeat some aliens, you will[b] earn at the end of the game an amount of points[/b] based on your actions during combats. Then with these points, you can [b]increase from the menu your health, speed, jumps, melee kicks, etc...[/b] up to 3 levels making it possible to beat larger hordes of aliens !

[img]http://actionalien.com/steam/2016_04_11/perks.jpg[/img]

[h1]Unlockable Weapons[/h1]
With these same points, you can also [b]unlock more powerful versions of the weapons of the game.[/b] There are 2 unlockable levels for each weapon, the first being the "upgraded" version and the second being the "golden" version. Upgraded weapons often consist of simply greater magazines, fire rates and damages, but golden weapons can have some real powerful abilities like the golden shotgun firing a large amount of explosive shrapnel or the golden grenade launcher firing multiples grenades in one shot !

[img]http://actionalien.com/steam/2016_04_11/unlockable_weapons.jpg[/img]

[img]http://actionalien.com/steam/2016_04_11/golden_shotgun.jpg[/img]

[img]http://actionalien.com/steam/2016_04_11/golden_m16.jpg[/img]

[h1]Cloud[/h1]
All these [b]progress will be saved on the Steam cloud when you are online[/b] so if you change your computer or if your HDD had an issue the progress won't be lost !

All these features will be of course improved over the time !

So it's pretty much all for this update, apart of some minor fixes and some improvements for the menu, the website has also been updated too.

What is now coming next is a bunch of small maps with a new game mode named "Survival", where the goal consist of resisting as long as possible against waves of aliens by using the increased perks and the new powerful unlockable weapons !

This next update should come soon.

Thanks for reading.

[i]Devdan[/i]
[url]http://actionalien.com[/url]

notes.title: New map for the game, the Tropical Hotel !
notes.content:
After months of work and with a lot of redesigning, I have finally managed to release the beta version of the new map that I have been announcing before !

This time you will find yourself stranded on the beach of a tropical island lost in the middle of the pacific ocean.

[img]http://actionalien.com/steam/2015_9_24/beta_tropical_1.jpg[/img]

Exploring the island, you will find a plane which may just require some attentions to be able to take off and all the things needed are in a luxurious hotel just next to the runway. Unfortunately, the aliens decided to use this hotel as their new home and won't really be friendly toward any strangers !

[img]http://actionalien.com/steam/2015_9_24/beta_tropical_2.jpg[/img]

The map is already fully playable but there are still some things I want to enhance like the foliages, the buildings, and also tweaking the difficulty.

[img]http://actionalien.com/steam/2015_9_24/beta_tropical_3.jpg[/img]

There is a lot of destroyable elements like the bungalows, windows, doors and pretty much all wood-based props. It is now also possible to get inside a building by breaking the door using a foot kick (with right mouse button).

[img]http://actionalien.com/steam/2015_9_24/beta_tropical_4.jpg[/img]

I have also worked on the AI of the aliens to make them acting more realistic, like roaming on the islands, wandering inside buildings...

[img]http://actionalien.com/steam/2015_9_24/beta_tropical_5.jpg[/img]

They may not attack you if you keep your distance and try to avoid them, but be careful because if one alien spot you all others around may start rushing you ! The aliens can of course swim and will track you under the water.

[img]http://actionalien.com/steam/2015_9_24/beta_tropical_6.jpg[/img]

The map is still in beta version, and so this is why until I manage to finish all the remaining work, I wanted to add the map in it's current playable state to receive some feedbacks from the players !

[img]http://actionalien.com/steam/2015_9_24/beta_tropical_7.jpg[/img]

I have added the map in a separate branch on Steam because I have rewritten a lot of code and the original map doesn't work yet with the new code !

[img]http://actionalien.com/steam/2015_9_24/beta_tropical_8.jpg[/img]

So for now to try the new map, find the game in your [i]Steam games library[/i], right click on it and open [i]Properties[/i]. Then go to [i]beta[/i] tab and choose [b]public_beta[/b] branch. It should download the beta and after that you just need launch the game !

If you have already played The Alien Wasteland, here are few things you may need to know before jumping into the action :
[list]
    [*] Right click is for foot kick !
    [*] Weapons and items are now laying on the ground instead of floating, to grab them just approach and press E on it.
    [*] It is now possible to display the current objectives and screen indicators by pressing Tab !
    [*] Use the big crates full of ammo to replenish your ammo stock, there are three of them in the islands.
[/list] 
So this will be all for this time ! Thank you for reading and let me know what you think about this map in the forum ! http://steamcommunity.com/app/382080/discussions/0/523898291491614673/

Coming next : [b]Redesigning and enhancing the Petrol Station map ![/b]

[i]Devdan[/i]
[url]http://actionalien.com[/url]

notes.title: New update with minor fixes and gameplay tweaking
notes.content:
After fixing the major bugs, I have been working on tweaking the gameplay to make it much better and easier to play.

Here is the list of what has been made :

[h1]UPDATE 30.06.2015[/h1]
 [list]
    [*]Fixed the aliens' AI who had sometime troubles getting on roofs.
    [*]Fixed the bug where aliens were still growling after being killed.
    [*]Fixed the high rate of footsteps sounds when running unarmed or with the baseball bat.
    [*]Added stamina to the baseball bat to prevent infinite smashing.
    [*]Lowered the damage range of the baseball bat.
    [*]Added wood crates under spawned weapons to make them more distinguishables.
    [*]Tweaked the waves so that the aliens will come from all sides of the map during the first 3 waves.
    [*]Lowered the friendly damages inflicted by grenades.
    [*]Added more in-game tips.
[/list]

So this will be all for this update. The game has been updated and is now solid.

Have fun !

notes.title: Major fixes for The Alien Wasteland
notes.content:
There have been many critical bugs with the game right after it's launch on Steam, some of which could actually break the game ! 

I am very sorry for the inconvenience caused by theses bugs, it is why I have been working hard these last days to fix them and I have now updated the game.

Here is a list of the all the bugs and problems I have fixed and some features I have changed in this update :

[h1]29.06.2015 UPDATE[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Fixed the [b]weapons and items which could be duplicated and stuck in the inventory if thrown very quickly or with the wrong button.[/b]
    [*]Fixed the [b]event who wasn't called when the player dies, resulting in not displaying the scores and preventing to get back to the menu.[/b]
    [*]Made possible [b]to skip the intro scene using space bar[/b] so when you play the game again, you don't have to bother with the intro.
    [*]Added a lot of tips to be displayed in-game to understand the gameplay mechanics.
    [*]Aliens' ragdolls physics has been fixed, however it does still need to be improved.
    [*]Enlarged the collision behind the car.
    [*][b]Changed the controls so to drop you current weapon use RIGHT MOUSE BUTTON instead of "T", and petrol cans can be dropped using both buttons of the mouse[/b]
    [*]You can now carry only one rifle or machine gun in your inventory, in addition of the pistol and the baseball bat.
    [*]Edited the tutorial screen displayed at the beginning of the game
[/list]
The update should apply automatically to the game, if not, try to restart Steam or to use the "Verify Intregrity of Game Cache" feature. If you have a doubt about whether or not the game has been updated, the current BuildID is 675682.

So this will be all for now, the game will continue to receive updates, especially for the aliens and their AI, and I am also planning to add achievements.

But before this, feel free to play the game and to post your review !

[i]Devdan[/i]
